subject: PrivDeploy architecture review & calendar alignment
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Emma Stone <emma.stone@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: PrivDeploy architecture review & calendar alignment

Hi Emma — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side:

- Recap: You want a Private (VPC) deployment with dedicated instances for PHI workloads, cross-region read replicas for DR, and customer-managed KMS. Key constraints: on-prem connectivity window in Q4, and strict retention/audit requirements for 7 years.
- Next step: technical deep-dive & architecture review (60–90 mins) with our infra engineers to validate network requirements, sizing, and IAM/KMS integration.

Proposed time windows (all PT):
- Tue 2026-09-15 09:00–10:30
- Wed 2026-09-16 13:00–14:30
- Thu 2026-09-17 15:00–16:30

If you prefer mornings/even earlier/later this week, happy to adjust. Attendees we plan to have: Sergio (private deployment lead), Rishi (solutions engineer), and myself. I attached a short discovery notes PDF and a preliminary infra checklist to help the team prepare.

Agenda draft:
1) Walkthrough of your current infra & constraints (15 min)
2) Redwood private deployment architecture & network patterns (25 min)
3) Open Q&A: KMS, audit logs, deployment timeline (20–40 min)

Please confirm which slot works and add any other internal attendees (network/security) you want on the call. If you want us to share a short read-ahead, we can post to the Drive link below.

Thanks — Moni

--
Monica Patel
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0126
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PrivDeploy-Discovery-Notes.pdf, Prelim-Infra-Checklist.xlsx
From: Emma Stone <emma.stone@nimbushealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 13:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy architecture review & calendar alignment

Thanks, Monica — that recap looks right. I looped in our infra lead, Liam, who will need to be on the architecture call. A couple notes up front:

- We prefer a 60-minute focused session (2 is fine if needed for follow-ups).
- Liam is only available afternoons PT next week. Our team is out the first half of next week for a board offsite, so Thu the 17th is the earliest realistic day.

Of your proposed times, Thu 2026-09-17 15:00–16:30 PT works best for us. If you can make it a tighter 60-minute agenda (15m for our infra overview, 30–35m for your architecture plus integration Qs, 10–15m for next steps), that would be ideal.

Also: can you share the read-ahead docs to a shared Drive folder and include any port/egress specifics you expect on the private deployment? Liam also asked whether Redwood supports time-limited SSO proofs for onboarding.

Emma
Head of IT Operations
Nimbus Health
emma.stone@nimbushealth.com | +1 312-555-0183
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Emma Stone <emma.stone@nimbushealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy architecture review & calendar alignment

Great — Thu 17th works. I'll schedule for 60 minutes at 15:00 PT and tighten the agenda as requested. Tentative agenda (tight 60m):

1) 15m - Nimbus infra + use cases (Emma + Liam)
2) 30m - Redwood Private architecture, network ports, KMS flow, and SSO onboarding patterns (Sergio + Rishi)
3) 10m - Action items & next steps (Monica + Grace)

Pre-call deliverables:
- I'll upload a 2-page read-ahead with port/egress table and KMS integration notes to the Drive folder and share the link in the invite.
- Regarding SSO: we support temporary onboarding tokens via short-lived cert exchange; we'll cover options during the call and include examples in the read-ahead.

Calendar invite will come from my account; please accept when it arrives. Feel free to add any other security folks — the more context we have up front, the faster we can finalize network requirements.

Thanks — Sergio
Senior Infra PM | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com

Perfect — slot accepted. Liam will also invite our security architect, Priya Rao (priya.rao@nimbushealth.com), so expect one more attendee. Looking forward to the read-ahead; please post to the Drive link and CC me so I can distribute to our team.

One small ask: can you include a short note in the read-ahead about audit log retention options and whether Redwood can push logs to our SIEM (we use Splunk Cloud)? If you can include a short example of log export configuration, that would help speed procurement and our internal review.

Thanks, Emma
